payload.description:
**Blocked by:** the Cognito user pool being deployed to development.

oidc-client-ts doing authorization code with PKCE against the Cognito app client, with identity_provider=Google on the authorize URL so Cognito's own page never renders and the person goes straight to Google. Tokens live in memory with silent renew, not in localStorage.

web/next.config.ts is output: export, so there is no Node runtime in the web tier and no server-side session. That is why the relying party is Cognito and the token is a bearer, not a cookie. web/lib/sse.ts already uses fetch rather than EventSource so it can send headers, so a bearer token needs no transport change.

**Done when:** a person signs in against development and the app holds a verified token.
payload.title: Sign in with Google from the web app
